name: supercharged_engine_air_flow
title: Supercharged engine air flow and compressor (TP6 exercise 1)
summary: Teaching exercise: air mass flow of a supercharged six-cylinder four-stroke engine, with the volumetric efficiency defined on the ambient density, and the turbocharger compressor and intercooler that follow.
